scoring_policy.claim_truth: Evaluate actual resulting claim with original query/time/platform/API scope; Aexpandedquote cannot repair falseclaim. Bcomplete source sentence not automatictruth.
scoring_policy.own_semantic_faithfulness: Compare meaning to full sourcecontext, bind negation, referents, explicitintro, platform/date. Local exactslice onlyprovenance.
scoring_policy.query_coverage: Each listed condition must appear in supported outputclaim AND ownquote; quotecoverage alone does not mean claimansweredquestion. Withheld/missing do not count as supported; no hiddenclaimcount denominator reduction.

cases.question: According to Python itertools.groupby documentation, does it group equal keys anywhere in the input or only consecutive runs, and how should input be prepared to collect all equal keys together?
cases.claim_text: The consecutive-only grouping is intentional and efficient, but it means the data must be pre-sorted on the grouping key.

witness.quote: This is intentional and efficient, but it means the data must be pre-sorted on the grouping key.

conditions: Sorting required only to collect all equal keys globally
gold.semantic_notes: Unconditional mandatory presorting is false; unsorted consecutive grouping valid.
gold.truth_basis: Frozen prior independent primarygold and ownwitness review; exact sentence alone not truthguarantee.
